You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26846, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone: read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` and `ui/AGENTS.md` before your first edit, and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself through REST (`curl -sS "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/NNNNN" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`, every page); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26846` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=26846 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6451014383, verbatim: "**p3:** five small Access-pillar defects (jargon in the duplicate-draft refusal, an OWD banner that outlives its revert, a stale set label in the rail, a clipped field counter, no re-grant for a dismissed suggestion). One PR is fine. Re-check the landing site on current `main`." No maintainer ruling.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure each on `origin/main` `07d18e69`; disproof welcome)

The QA run was at `3fcafcd3`. Since then this lane landed #27064 (draft objects in the matrix), #27080 (package-door save base) and #27025 (Tab visibility input) in the same files. Re-reproduce each item first and drop any that no longer reproduces, saying so.

1. **Duplicate-draft refusal jargon:** "this save asserted that no draft row exists (the first-write pin, If-None-Match: *…)" is most likely the server's 412/409 message shown raw. Find where the Access "+ New" create surfaces it (the first-write pin is set in `ResourceEditPage.tsx` ≈L1771 and the draft guard in `DraftConflictDialog.tsx`). Map that refusal, by its code and not its text, to an author-facing i18n string ("A draft with this name already exists in this package"), en + zh, with the key in `@object-ui/i18n`. ⛔ Do not change the server message.
2. **OWD refusal banner outliving revert:** the save-refusal bullet must clear when the draft returns to the saved baseline ("No changes"). Find the refusal state in `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` and clear it on revert or dirty→clean.
3. **Stale set label in the Studio rail:** an autosaved rename or label edit must show in the Access rail without publish or reload. Find the rail's list source and refresh it on the editor's `onDraftSaved` (the hook other pillars already use), not by polling.
4. **Clipped field counter / non-sticky name column:** at 1440×900 the "14 / 14" counter is clipped, and at 900px the field-name column is not sticky. Fix with layout classes in the matrix's field table. Pin with a test that asserts the class or structure; no screenshot test.
5. **No re-grant for a dismissed suggestion:** `SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx` / `services/suggestedBindingsApi.ts`. Measure whether the server offers a door to restore a dismissed or revoked suggestion. If it does, add the control. If it does not, ⛔ do not invent an endpoint: leave item 5 out, and say so in the report so the seat can file a server-side card.

### Scope

File surface: `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, the Access rail in `views/studio-design/` (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` or its AccessPillar), `SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx` / `suggestedBindingsApi.ts`, the refusal mapping site, `@object-ui/i18n` locale keys (en + zh, plus whatever the repo's i18n gates demand for the other locales), and tests. One test per item, each with an ablation. Stay under 3000 changed lines.

Serial: PR #26999 (#26858) is queued and edits `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` (the RLS verdict) and `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. Merge `origin/main` before your gates. Any new matrix-mounting test fake needs `withPreviewDrafts` and `getDraft` (see #27095).

### Tier

No path-derived mandate expected (quote `dispatch-gates --tier`). `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium`. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. A changeset for `@object-ui/i18n` (patch) only if you add keys there; otherwise `skip-changeset`.
